WoW Addon

B.O.L.T

B.O.L.T (Brittle and Occasionally Lethal Tweaks) makes the World of Warcraft interface cleaner without replacing it: small modules restyle Blizzard's own frames with Blizzard's own art. Portrait-less unit frames, a square minimap with one button bar, bars that fade until needed, nameplates that flag mana users and interruptible casts. Each module is switched on on its own and set from Edit Mode, on Midnight and on WoW: Forever.

Features

  • Game Menu enhancements (Leave Group, Reload UI, Group Tools)
  • Portrait-less unit frames and cast bars in Blizzard's own art
  • Square minimap with one button bar and an addon button drawer
  • Auto-hide for action bars, frames, buffs and the quest tracker
  • Nameplates: mana users, interrupt cue, range hint
  • Options inside Edit Mode, saved per layout
  • Midnight and WoW: Forever from one addon
  • 140+ releases shipped by CI/CD
